title: Coleslaw
description: Creamy, tangy, classic BBQ side. Adapted from Serious Eats.
steps: Toss cabbage and carrots with 1 tsp Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Drain in a colander 30 minutes, then press dry (don't rinse).
Whisk mayo, sugar, vinegar, mustard, celery seed.
Pour over cabbage. Toss to coat.
Taste, then season with pepper and more salt if needed.
notes: Salting cabbage first draws out moisture.
